description: 14-step scripted task. The driver sends one prompt per turn, waits for the assistant to either return a tool call (recorded) or end the turn, then sends the next. Steps mix auto-allowed reads with non-auto-allowed bash and write operations.
steps: Run `git status` to show the working tree.
Run `git log --oneline -20` to show recent history.
Use `rg TrustMode src/` to find all occurrences across src/.
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to type-check the project.
Use `find . -name '*.ts' -newer package.json -not -path './node_modules/*'` to list recently-modified TypeScript files.
Create a new file `ab-test-sandbox.txt` in the repo root containing the literal string `hello`.
Append the literal line "test complete" to `ab-test-sandbox.txt` using the Edit tool.
